package internalapi

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
	"io"
	"mime"
	"net/http"
	"reflect"
	"strings"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

type HybridApplicationService interface {
	Apply(context.Context, string, string, domain.HybridConsequence) (domain.HybridApplicationReceipt, error)
}

func (h *Handler) ApplyHybridConsequence(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	if h.HybridApplication == nil {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 503, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE")
		return
	}
	typ, _, err := mime.ParseMediaType(r.Header.Get("Content-Type"))
	if err != nil || typ != "application/json" {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	raw, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, domain.MaximumPlanningSnapshotRequestBytes))
	if err != nil || !utf8.Valid(raw) {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.UseNumber()
	value, err := readPlanningSnapshotJSONValue(decoder, 0)
	if err != nil || !hybridCanonicalJSONKeys(value) {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	if _, err = decoder.Token(); err != io.EOF {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	var c domain.HybridConsequence
	decoder = json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&c) != nil || decoder.Decode(&struct{}{}) != io.EOF {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	if !hybridRequiredJSONShape(raw, reflect.TypeOf(c)) {
		writePlanningSnapshotError(w, 400, "HYBRID_INVALID")
		return
	}
	if err := domain.ValidateHybridConsequence(c); err != nil {
		writeHybridApplicationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	receipt, err := h.HybridApplication.Apply(r.Context(), chi.URLParam(r, "studentID"), chi.URLParam(r, "pathID"), c)
	if err != nil {
		writeHybridApplicationError(w, err)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(receipt)
}
func hybridRequiredJSONShape(raw json.RawMessage, typ reflect.Type) bool {
	if bytes.Equal(bytes.TrimSpace(raw), []byte("null")) {
		return false
	}
	for typ.Kind() == reflect.Pointer {
		typ = typ.Elem()
	}
	if typ.PkgPath() == "time" && typ.Name() == "Time" {
		return true
	}
	switch typ.Kind() {
	case reflect.Struct:
		var fields map[string]json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &fields) != nil {
			return false
		}
		for i := 0; i < typ.NumField(); i++ {
			f := typ.Field(i)
			parts := strings.Split(f.Tag.Get("json"), ",")
			if parts[0] == "-" {
				continue
			}
			key := parts[0]
			if key == "" {
				key = f.Name
			}
			value, present := fields[key]
			if !present {
				if len(parts) > 1 && parts[1] == "omitempty" {
					continue
				}
				return false
			}
			if !hybridRequiredJSONShape(value, f.Type) {
				return false
			}
		}
	case reflect.Slice:
		var values []json.RawMessage
		if json.Unmarshal(raw, &values) != nil || values == nil {
			return false
		}
		for _, value := range values {
			if !hybridRequiredJSONShape(value, typ.Elem()) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}
func hybridCanonicalJSONKeys(value any) bool {
	switch v := value.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		for k, child := range v {
			if k != strings.ToLower(k) || !hybridCanonicalJSONKeys(child) {
				return false
			}
		}
	case []any:
		for _, child := range v {
			if !hybridCanonicalJSONKeys(child) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}
func writeHybridApplicationError(w http.ResponseWriter, err error) {
	status, code := 500, "HYBRID_UNAVAILABLE"
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridStale):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_STALE"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridIntentRequired):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_INTENT_REQUIRED"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridUnsafe):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_UNSAFE"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridConflict), errors.Is(err, domain.ErrConflict):
		status, code = 409, "HYBRID_CONFLICT"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrHybridUnsupported):
		status, code = 422, "HYBRID_UNSUPPORTED"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrValidation):
		status, code = 422, "HYBRID_INVALID"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrNotFound):
		status, code = 404, "HYBRID_NOT_FOUND"
	case errors.Is(err, domain.ErrForbidden):
		status, code = 403, "HYBRID_FORBIDDEN"
	}
	writePlanningSnapshotError(w, status, code)
}
